tracks.title: 한 개 더
tracks.mood: tender, shy and bright, like an 80s idol ballad-pop song (an ordinary Wednesday closing time)
tracks.subject: Sung by a 19-year-old part-timer at a Sinchon donut counter: every Wednesday ten minutes before closing a tired man buys one plain glazed and eats it standing; this week she has read his birthday off his points card and slips a second, pink-sprinkle donut into his box.
